title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: Outward markers of that estrangement are then described: new greetings, altered forms, and especially red dress are set against the Guru-given Khalsa pattern.
The page argues that these changes are not superficial but signs that Banda has turned against the Guru’s tested path and is fashioning a rival identity.
Red dress is the strongest anchor because it makes theological drift visible in bodily form.
